PublishingInfo.Description: Object Detection (YOLO26) optimized for Python 3.12, Numpy 2.2.3, PyTorch 2.6.0, Ultralytics 8.4.14, CUDA 12.4, cuDNN 9
PublishingInfo.Stack: Python, Numpy, PyTorch, CUDA, cuDNN, YOLO26
PublishingInfo.Author: Mark D. Renard

ModuleReleases.ReleaseNotes: Initial release for Windows x64 with NVIDIA RTX GPU
Upgrades to python, numpy, pytorch, torchvision, setuptools, opencv-python, urllib3, ultralytics, CUDA, cuDNN. See (requirements.txt) for specific versions.

RouteMaps.Name: Object Detector (YOLO26)
RouteMaps.Description: Detection of multiple objects in an image.

Inputs.Name: min_confidence
Inputs.Description: The minimum confidence for an object being detected. Range 0.0 to 1.0. Default 0.4.

Outputs.Name: success
Outputs.Description: True if successful.

Outputs.Name: message
Outputs.Description: A summary of the inference operation.

Outputs.Name: error
Outputs.Description: (Optional) An description of the error if success was false.

Outputs.Name: predictions
Outputs.Description: An array of objects with the x_max, x_min, max, y_min, label and confidence.

Outputs.Name: count
Outputs.Description: The number of objects found.

Outputs.Name: inferenceMs
Outputs.Description: The time (ms) to perform the AI inference.

Outputs.Name: processMs
Outputs.Description: The time (ms) to process the image (includes inference and image manipulation operations).

RouteMaps.Name: Custom Object Detector (YOLO26)
RouteMaps.Description: Detects multiple custom objects in an image.

Inputs.Name: image
Inputs.Description: The HTTP image to be analyzed.

Inputs.Name: min_confidence
Inputs.Description: The minimum confidence level for an object will be detected. Range 0.0 to 1.0. Default 0.4.

Outputs.Name: success
Outputs.Description: True if successful.

Outputs.Name: message
Outputs.Description: A summary of the inference operation.

Outputs.Name: error
Outputs.Description: (Optional) An description of the error if success was false.

Outputs.Name: predictions
Outputs.Description: An array of objects with the x_max, x_min, max, y_min, mask, label and confidence.

Outputs.Name: inferenceMs
Outputs.Description: The time (ms) to perform the AI inference.

Outputs.Name: processMs
Outputs.Description: The time (ms) to process the image (includes inference and image manipulation operations).
